The '''Jarl forest''' was a [[Forest/Legends|forest]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ingo/Legends|Ingo]]. In [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]], [[Thall Joben/Legends|Thall Joben]] hid the stolen [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Trigon One]]'' in the Jarl forest, near a [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]]-shaped rock formation, in order to keep it out of the hands of the [[Fromm Gang/Legends|Fromm Gang]].
